engines.quant: Apple MLX distributed inference over RDMA (the Apple research blog's setup). Apple publicly released NO single tok/s figure in the announcement itself; the widely-quoted 'over 36 tokens per second' (see the 2026-10-23/24 captures) comes from Apple's distributed-inference write-up on four Studios. Two Studios are Meta's documented minimum for ~1TB of unified memory, four reach 16-37 tok/s depending on count
